scope: Planning only for 65 physical editions present before publication, against exactly 259 successfully published digital editions; 191 held records excluded.
identity_policy: Exact NFC/space/case title and subtitle with ordered authors. Literal surname-comma inversion is allowed; no accents stripping, fuzzy matching, partial title matching or author merges.
object_policy: Each physical edition keeps its own SKU and CDN object. A hypothetical byte reuse must be copied to covers/editions/v2/{physicalSKU}-{sourceSHA256[:12]}.webp and verified before any future coverUrl update. Never assign a digital-SKU object URL to a physical edition.
